about: The final teaser narration: three takes per line (seeds in TAKE_SEEDS), each trimmed to the speech (50 ms before, 250 ms after), faded, and two-pass loudness-normalised to -16 LUFS integrated, true peak at or under -1.5 dBTP. "picked" is the take chosen by the rule in final.mjs (pick). Word timings are in the edit copy's time and come from the character alignment.

defects: sound at the start of the file
last word 0.161 s off the speech end

lines.text: And every people deserves a kingdom.
Every minute in chat… a light in the window.
Come back… and it grows with you.
Friends arrive under their own banners.
Thousands of chats. Thousands of kingdoms.
